## Verification

- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run security:check`

## Security Checklist

- [ ] I did not commit real API keys, tokens, passwords, private keys, cookies, or credentials.
- [ ] Any new environment variables are documented in `.env.example` and do not expose secrets to browser-delivered code.
- [ ] I reviewed dependency changes and can explain why any new package is needed.
- [ ] I avoided unsafe DOM sinks such as `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, `innerHTML`, `document.write`, and `eval`.
- [ ] I considered loading, error, and fallback states for any new network request.
